attrs.evidence: R5.1 added `evidence_refs` to the argument record as free-text strings and no gate read the field. GPT-5.6 set one to `scripts/DOES-NOT-EXIST.mjs`, regenerated the receipt digest so the change would not be masked, and check-mosaic.mjs still exited 0: an argument could claim support from an artifact that was not there. Reproduced. The refs are now `{kind: witness, path, section?}`, `{kind: claim, ref}` or `{kind: source, ref}`, each resolved against the filesystem or the matching registry. The `source_refs` edge that MOS-SUPPORT-RELEVANCE needs for its citation binding is DERIVED from the typed support rather than stored as a second list, because a copied edge that nobody recomputes is exactly the failure this round is repairing one file over in the receipt.
attrs.statement: An argument's support references are typed — witness, claim or source — and every one resolves. What can be derived from them, such as the set of sources an argument rests on, is derived and never stored beside them.
